title: Plasma: verify PathPilot v2.14.4 G21 M207/M208 units, AutoFS overrides, and G41.1 kerf side

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
Confirms four unmeasured PathPilot v2.14.4 1300PL behaviors recorded on PR #679, updates `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` if `M207`/`M208` units differ under `G21`, and documents the `M207` Z-limit load warning.

## Context

- PR #679 ran the three `tormach-plasma` golden files to `M30` on PathPilot Hub (`1300PL SIM`, PathPilot v2.14.4).
- That run left four runtime behaviors unmeasured:
  1. Under `G21`, `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` writes metric values such as `M207 P3.8` (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-plasma/plasma_plate_with_holes_mm.nc`). PathPilot shows no visual pierce-height readout, so whether `M207 P` and `M208 P` read millimeters or inches under `G21` remains unconfirmed.
  2. Whether `M207`/`M208`/`M209` after `M200` override AutoFS values at runtime remains unmeasured.
  3. Whether feedless `G1` moves after `M200` take the AutoFS feed remains unisolated because the tested golden files emit `F` words.
  4. Whether `G41.1 D<kerf>` offsets to the waste side rather than the part side remains unmeasured at high zoom.
- On load, PathPilot displays a warning `"Program exceeds machine maximum on Z axis by 0.1496 in"` when `M207` is present, because Z0 rests at the top of travel before `G15` probes.

## Requirements

- Verify those four behaviors against public Tormach documentation or a clean-room PathPilot v2.14.4 Hub or 1300PL machine test (behavior only).
- If `M207`/`M208` always read inches under `G21` (like `G64 P0.005 Q0.005`), update `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` and regenerate the metric golden test.
- Add a short operator note in `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md` (and post notes if helpful) explaining the harmless `M207` Z-max load warning.

Done means: public docs or PathPilot 1300PL runtime tests confirm all four items, any required unit fix in `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` has passing golden tests, and `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md` documents the `M207` load warning.

Part of #621
